- [2023/05/27] Knicks Go is a retired Thoroughbred racehorse, foaled on January 29, 2016.
- [2023/05/27] Knicks Go was the 2021 American Horse of the Year, winning five of seven starts, including the Breeders' Cup Classic, Whitney Stakes, and Pegasus World Cup.
- [2023/05/27] In 2020, Knicks Go won the Breeders' Cup Dirt Mile.
- [2023/05/27] Knicks Go is the sixth horse to win two different Breeders' Cup races.
- [2023/05/27] Knicks Go won the Breeders' Futurity in 2018 and finished second in the Breeders' Cup Juvenile.
- [2023/05/27] Knicks Go finished second in the 2022 Pegasus World Cup and was then retired to stud at Taylor Made Farm in Nicholasville, Kentucky, with an initial stud fee of $30,000.
- [2023/05/27] Knicks Go is a gray horse bred by Angie Moore and her daughter Sabrina at GreenMount Farm in Reisterstown, Maryland.
- [2023/05/27] Knicks Go was sold as a weanling for $40,000 at the 2016 Keeneland November sale and resold as a yearling for $87,000 to the Korea Racing Authority.
